title: ChatGPT is adding real cartoonists' signatures to fake New Yorker cartoons
summary: A Nieman Lab report discusses ChatGPT generating fake New Yorker-style cartoons that include real cartoonists' forged signatures, raising concerns about attribution, copyright, and AI misuse. The Hacker News discussion (495 points, 364 comments) debates the ethical and legal implications of LLMs mimicking artists' work and identities without consent.
